advice_items.quote: boredom is a thing that you always have to overcome no matter what... there's only so many beaches you can go and hang out on before you want to do something again
advice_items.summary_en: Even after retiring wealthy, you need meaningful work to overcome boredom and stay fulfilled.
advice_items.summary_zh: 财富自由后仍需寻找有意义的事

advice_items.quote: it's essential if you want to understand the size of the world and you want to understand even markets
advice_items.summary_en: Travel internationally to understand how large the world is and spot global market opportunities.
advice_items.summary_zh: 多出国旅行以开拓全球市场视野

advice_items.quote: if I do something real easy that I enjoy doing it kind of breaks the ice and then I kind of get on a roll
advice_items.summary_en: Use daily to-do lists and start with easy, enjoyable tasks to break procrastination and build momentum.
advice_items.summary_zh: 列待办清单，先做易事打破拖延

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: anybody who asked me like oh where should I start in the tech world if I wanted to have a guaranteed career I tell them cyber security
advice_items.summary_en: Enter cybersecurity and information security, a massive, permanent industry with guaranteed long-term demand.
advice_items.summary_zh: 入局高增长的网络安全行业

advice_items.quote: pick something you want to be spending a lot of time with... even the most successful companies usually take three to five years minimum
advice_items.summary_en: Execution is hard and takes 3 to 5+ years, so choose a venture you truly enjoy working on every day.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选能坚持三到五年以上的热爱事业

advice_items.quote: it's not just your mental health it's your physical health... if I do that too many days in a row it also depletes my creativity
advice_items.summary_en: Protect your physical and mental health by breaking up long work stretches so you don't deplete your creativity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 重视身心健康，适时休息恢复创造力

advice_items.quote: start in a service industry and try to get some income coming in... or if you've got the skill set take the year off of work and write it yourself
advice_items.summary_en: With modest capital ($100k), start a cash-flowing service business or invest in yourself to build the product yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 有限资金先做服务业或靠自己动手研发

advice_items.quote: the key is to remind yourself that it's temporary and plan for that you know that's why savings accounts are good
advice_items.summary_en: Remember that recessions only last a couple of years; plan ahead and keep cash in savings accounts.
advice_items.summary_zh: 牢记衰退只是暂时的，保持储蓄缓冲

advice_items.quote: recessions are not always a bad thing you if you've got the capital and you can spend it and do it that's a great time to deploy it
advice_items.summary_en: Recessions are an ideal time to start a company or deploy capital because labor and costs are lower.
advice_items.summary_zh: 趁经济衰退期低成本创业并逆势布局

advice_items.quote: stick to what you know or learn something and learn really deep on it and I think so often people shotgun
advice_items.summary_en: Stick to what you know and go deep into one industry instead of chasing trends and scattering your focus.
advice_items.summary_zh: 深耕熟悉领域，切忌盲目追风口分散精力

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫寒，童年随父做屋顶工、刷盘子贴补家用；14岁左右自学编程并接外包，16岁高中辍学全职工作；早年深耕信息安全（曾培训FBI/CIA/IRS等机构），90年代末与朋友联合创办互联网公司并于1999年上市，后以10.3亿美元合并出售。
guests.role_or_title: Tech Entrepreneur & Information Security Pioneer (New Startup Founder)
guests.wealth_detail: Sold co-founded .com company for $1.03B (described by host as multi-millionaire)
guests.zero_start_advice: 科技新人建议切入高增长的网络安全/信息安全领域；若有10万美元启动资金，可先做服务业快速产生现金流，或凭技术能力全职投入一年自己打造产品；选择能热爱并深耕3-5年以上的赛道，专注熟悉领域，并在经济衰退期低成本布局或保持现金储备。
